items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: Who else was on the record with you with Maz? ... Maz and Benny Carter was on it, I know that.

ctx.x: Yeah, well you dig all the stuff out and then we'll come. Well, that's, yeah I'd like, see I'd like to make a tape of that. Who else was on the record with you with Maz?
I'm trying to think now. Maz and Benny Carter was on it, I know that.
